summary: SLM-CPU-211 defines a receipt-bound no-bias selector descriptor and DenseLinearRuntimeHookDescriptor can carry it, but candidate-off/candidate-on strict warm-session receipts cannot be captured yet because the warm-session receipt gate identity is not propagated into the model's dense-linear runtime hook registry. Model hooks are built from GGUF sidecars before prompt/generated/text digests exist and currently set receipt_bound_no_bias_selector=null, so FeedForward::apply_linear cannot prove the SLM-CPU-209 identity at candidate execution time.

runtime_propagation_observation.hook_selector_reason: model-loading sidecar descriptors do not have prompt/generated/text digest identity
missing_for_candidate_on_receipts: propagate DenseLinearNoBiasReceiptBoundSelectorDescriptor from warm-session receipt identity into DenseLinearRuntimeHookRegistry
bind descriptor lifetime to exact prompt/generated/text digests after prompt execution or define a per-callsite candidate execution receipt emitted after execution
select candidate only when explicit runtime gate is requested and descriptor identity matches the current model/session
capture candidate-off and candidate-on strict warm-session receipts proving generated IDs and decoded text are preserved
keep default eager_f32_candle path when no descriptor is present

safe_next_slice.scope: define a session-scoped no-bias selector propagation boundary or per-callsite candidate execution receipt emitter that can attach DenseLinearNoBiasReceiptBoundSelectorDescriptor identity after prompt digests are known
must_remain_fail_closed_until: descriptor identity matches model SHA, architecture, quant format, tokenizer authority, runtime_api, selected_backend, fallback=false, and prompt/generated/text digests
candidate-off/candidate-on strict warm-session receipts preserve generated IDs and decoded text
